title: Black SUVs, helicopters and a 30 ft hole near the crash site

tellings.quote: we found came across a hole and it was about 30 ft deep, 30 ft in diameter, kind of like a circular hole.

plain: A man named Brett Lanner says that in 1999 at Hart Canyon near Aztec, New Mexico, a place where a UFO with alien bodies is said to have crashed, he saw black SUVs and helicopters and came across a round hole about 30 feet deep and 30 feet wide. Lanner tells Michels he found it himself: "we came across a hole and it was about 30 ft deep, 30 ft in diameter, kind of like a circular hole." If true, someone was still digging at the crash site decades later.
